pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 80 °C·d above 5 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1400 °C·d$(). Best near 25 °C; stops above 35 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -4 °C (-1.5 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-8 (tolerates 5.5-8.8). Roots 0.8 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 110, P 12, K 60 kg/ha per crop; fixes about 65% of its own nitrogen.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 1606 lb/ac (1.8 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Chickpeas.
